description: OnlyDans org-wide dependency policy — the ONE home (hub preset, per Ironworks doctrine). Products extend with `github>OnlyDans-ai/renovate-config` and override only repo-specifics. Change policy here; all repos inherit.

packageRules.description: JS ecosystems (npm/yarn/pnpm via the npm manager): the lockfile regenerates WITH the bump — cures the bumped-manifest-stale-lock CI disease (staffcloud PR #105/#106 receipt)
Python (pep621/uv): uv.lock regenerates with every pyproject bump (staffcloud 2026-06-03 cure)
Dev-only dependencies: automerge patch+minor once CI is green — never touches a prod artifact, so the bot may finish the job
GitHub Actions: monthly, grouped, automerge patch/minor/digest
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: MAJORS are Danny-gated via the Dependency Dashboard checkbox — the bot recommends, a human decides (house rule: recommend-never-auto). LAST rule so it wins over any automerge above
